query:
SELECT
                session_id AS "session_id!",
                action_id AS "action_id!",
                opened_at IS NOT NULL AS "opened!",
                COALESCE(prepared_at > now() - make_interval(secs => $3), false)
                    AS "may_still_open!"
            FROM factory_step
            WHERE run_id = $1 AND seq = $2 AND session_id IS NOT NULL
